description: Insights Hub is Siemens' industrial Internet of Things platform for manufacturing, the evolution of its earlier MindSphere platform. It collects equipment and process data to measure overall equipment effectiveness (availability, performance and quality), manage energy with machine learning to find inefficiencies and shave peaks, support predictive, preventive or reactive maintenance through an asset health module, and predict quality problems from process data, with AI assistants called Production Copilot and Copilot Studio. It is produced by Siemens. Coverage is global, with customers running many plants and thousands of connected devices. It is sold commercially; the product page gives no price, licence terms or details of deployment and connectivity, which are treated here as a cloud service. Caveats: the page is marketing material, and the platform suits plant owners, not outside researchers, since data stay within each customer's tenancy. For simulation it provides the operational data layer of factory digital twins, feeding maintenance, energy and quality optimisation models and resilience analyses of production assets. It is related to the AVEVA PI System record in this catalogue, another industrial data platform.
